title: ApexAmphion designs antibiotic peptides: 100/100 designed peptides active in vitro
summary: 100 designed peptides all showed low MIC (nanomolar for some); 99 of 100 were broad-spectrum against at least two clinically relevant bacteria; lead molecules acted on the cytoplasmic membrane. Preprint; in vitro only; no in vivo or toxicity assessment in the abstract; affiliations unverified.
